fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: CRB CODE
fields.description: The code the reporting Credit Reference Bureau (E.g. XYZ = 060002)

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING DAY, MONTH & YEAR
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency.

fields.name: CATEGORY OF INSTITUTION
fields.description: Category of instutition. E.g. Comercial Banks, Microfinance Banks, DBFB Banks, Regulated Saccos, Unregulated Saccos, etc

fields.name: SUBMITTING INSTITUTION CODE
fields.description: Institution Code of the submitting instutition. E.g. Bank code issued by KBA (e.g. KCB = 01) for Commercial Banks.

fields.name: TYPE OF CREDIT FACILITY
fields.description: The type of credit facility applied for. I.e. {Secured or Unsecured}

fields.name: PRODUCT TYPE
fields.description: The type of product applied for E.g. {Overdraft, Credit Card, Business Working Capital, Business Expansion Loans, Mortgage Loans, Asset Finance Loans, Trade Finance Loans, Mobile Banking Loans and Others, etc}

fields.name: APPLICATION STATUS
fields.description: The status of the new credit applications. E.g. {Approved, Pending, Awaiting documents, Securities Perfection, Declined, Withdrawn, Pending Disbursements, etc}

fields.name: NO OF APPLICATIONS
fields.description: The count on the number of new credit applications per type of credit facility, application status and submitting institution

fields.name: AMOUNT
fields.description: The amount of new credit application per type of credit facility, application status and submitting institution
